sourceNotes.rawContent: A delicate heart-in-circle bracelet with subtle crystal detailing, perfect for adding a romantic touch to your everyday style. Lightweight, trendy, and effortlessly chic—ideal for casual wear and special moments alike. To preserve its radiant silver-toned luster, keep this high-fashion piece away from moisture and perfumes, and store it in a dry place after every wear.
